simple.meaning: בְּעָתָה (bᵉʻâthâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “fear.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בְּעָתָה (H1205) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 8:15, with occurrences in Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּעָתָה (H1205) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בְּעָתָה (H1205) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בְּעָתָה (bᵉʻâthâh) / H1205 is traced through Jeremiah 8:15, Jeremiah 14:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
